retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1970s disco aesthetic featuring glowing neon script over a warm red-to-purple airbrushed gradient with high-contrast fashion silhouettes.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy composition dominated by a large, glowing white neon script that appears to float over a smooth vertical gradient of red, magenta, and purple. The scene is framed by dark, high-contrast silhouettes of fashion accessories like glasses and high-heeled shoes.
coreVisualRelationships: Central glowing script as the primary focal point
Vertical color gradient providing depth and mood
Secondary blocky neon text at the top for hierarchy
coreInvariants: White neon glow effect on all typography
High-contrast black and white peripheral elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large expressive script occupies the center-right; secondary text is centered at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'Get Down' style script acts as the central weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, follow the sweeping curves of the central script, and settle on the bottom-right silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open gradient areas in the center-left and bottom-left provide breathing room for the glow.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with maximum value (white) in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Script uses continuous, fluid monoline strokes with exaggerated loops
Upper text uses a geometric, wide-set skeleton with connected bars
All strokes are rendered as glowing neon tubes with a soft outer halo
characterSpecificRedesigns: G and C in the top line are stylized with extended horizontal bars
The script 'G' features a massive circular flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, expressive script paired with a rigid, geometric display face.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, glowing monoline aesthetic
Matches the geometric structure of the top title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a smooth vertical airbrush gradient transitioning from vibrant red at the top to magenta in the middle and deep purple at the bottom. Place a high-contrast silhouette of a high-heeled shoe in the bottom right and glasses in the top left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white glowing neon script in the center with a secondary geometric neon title at the top. Ensure the glow bleeds softly into the background colors.

verificationChecks: Is the gradient smooth and vertical?
Does the text have a soft white outer glow?
Are the silhouettes pure black or high-contrast?
Is the script monoline and loopy?

avoid: Hard edges on the neon glow

postGenerationChecks: Verify neon glow doesn't obscure letter legibility
Ensure silhouettes don't overlap the main text
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Airbrush Gradient: Red to Purple] + [Neon Script: White Glow] + [Framing: High-Contrast Silhouettes] for a 70s disco aesthetic.
